worker_ask.tldr: Worker reached the local-agent ⇄ coordinator unreachable posture for the lease path and the contract isn't fully unambiguous on what counts as a 'fresh lease' for a worker that holds a valid local lease but whose last coordinator-side renew is older than HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL.
worker_ask.ask: When the coordinator is unreachable and the local agent holds a lease whose locally-known expires_at is still in the future but whose last successful coordinator-side renew is older than HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL, should the worker treat the lease as 'still held' (continue the in-flight task) or 'stale' (stop cleanly mid-task)?

options.label: Continue — locally-valid lease is sufficient under degraded-closed
options.blast_radius: Preserves in-flight work across longer coordinator blips at the cost of widening the BC-04 race window if a second runner ever claims the same task after lease propagation lag.

options.label: Stop — heartbeat-staleness collapses the lease, finish cleanly and surrender
options.blast_radius: Tightens the BC-04 race floor to one HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL of staleness at the cost of killing in-flight work during normal coordinator blips that the local lease TTL was sized to survive.

recommendation.why: The local lease TTL was explicitly sized larger than HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL + expected blip exactly to preserve in-flight work; collapsing on heartbeat staleness would defeat the sizing rationale and re-introduce the BC-34 mid-work-kill scar.

worker_ask.reversible: Either choice is reversible — the policy is one constant + one branch in the local-agent's tick loop; reversing it doesn't require a data migration.
